column3: ## References are shown in the article metadata form

column1: Depends on Article References : Article References : Preparation

column3: Go to the "Enter Article Metadata" tab in the "Publisher Area"

column4: The field is a multi-line textarea
The help text reads: One reference per line

column3: Fill in the required fields for a new article (title, author, Full-Text URL and the journal ISSNs) and enter 3 references in the "References" field, one per line, leaving a blank line between two of them

column4: At the top of the page you see the confirmation message: Article created/updated

column3: Open the public page of the article you have just created

column4: The 3 references are shown in the "References" section, in the order you entered them
The blank line has not created an empty reference

column3: Create another article without entering anything in the "References" field, then open its public page
